inherited_details.title: A More Credible Approach to Parallel Trends
inherited_details.version: Published Review of Economic Studies 90(5), 2023, pages 2555–2591; advance access 15 February 2023; DOI 10.1093/restud/rdad018
inherited_details.type: Published journal PDF hosted on an author's website, although the listing link is labeled Draft
inherited_details.text_scope: Physical pages 1–12 / printed 2555–2566: setup, identified set, restriction families, inferential goal and start of moment-inequality representation.
inherited_details.page_number_rule: Printed page equals physical page plus 2554; physical page 1 confirms published identity.
inherited_details.verified_scope: The reduced form separates treatment effects from counterfactual trend departures, with zero pre-treatment effects. Restrictions on departures identify a set. Relative-magnitude restrictions bound consecutive first differences; smoothness bounds second differences. Zero smoothness permits a linear differential trend. Identified sets and confidence sets address different uncertainty.
inherited_details.equation_cautions: Normalize delta_0=0 and justify the reduced form first. Do not treat contaminated raw TWFE leads as clean pretrend departures. Generic closed-convex endpoint language in Lemma 2.1 needs attainment qualifications; the independent caution below supplies them. No pretest proves the missing counterfactual.
inherited_details.not_adopted: General uniform-inference, ARP conditional-testing, power, FLCI or software guarantees. Their later proofs and supplementary material were not inspected.
inherited_details.chapter_use: Reduced-form/departure decomposition, relative-increment versus curvature sensitivity, and the difference between identified and confidence sets. Compact fibers and original square sharpness are proved directly, as is a separate finite known-Gaussian projection.
inherited_details.verification: Exact scoped primary inspection reused from frozen bs_author preparation, which root fully read. No new full-document or appendix inspection claimed by chapter author.

sources.limits: No new empirical findings, complete-paper audit, actual study, source-problem reproduction or expanded method verification.
